newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil policeman kills boy in front of brother.
newsitem.headline: Brazil policeman kills boy in front of brother.

text.p: A police detective shot and killed a 14-year old boy in front of his brother while questioning the two youths over the theft of a videocassette recorder, Brazilian police said Friday.

A spokesman said detective Gladston Ferreira da Silva was not even involved in the case but had taken the boy and his 16-year old brother without the investigating officer's knowledge to another room for interrogation.

"According to the victim's brother, he started beating them and then took out his gun, waving it around and asking them if they had ever seen a gun being fired before. The gun then went off," the spokesman said. The shooting took place Thursday in Justinopolis, Minas Gerais state.
The spokesman said Da Silva had "personal and work-related problems," and was currently in hiding.
